name: NovaChem HazGuard Enforcement Full Kit
description: Acid-yellow and charcoal-grey sealed hazmat-tactical hybrid armor, with NovaChem's diamond-and-droplet logo printed in reflective silver across the chest plate and full-face respirator mask housing. The helmet is a positive-pressure sealed unit with integrated chemical sensor array and four-hour internal air supply, dual-purpose for enforcement and spill response. Load rig carries chemical dispersal grenades, a pressurized neutralizing agent sprayer, and restraint gear, all sealed in chemically inert pouches. Boots are fully sealed knee-high chemical-resistant composite, heat-bonded to the suit trousers with watertight gaskets.
functionality: Full chemical and biological hazard protection, integrated sensor array for compound identification, and enforcement-grade load capacity for riot and spill response.
what_it_says: NovaChem enforces its own cleanup standards — and decides what counts as a spill versus a suppression action.
story_hooks: A HazGuard unit's chemical sensor keeps reading an unknown compound at a site NovaChem officially declared clean six months ago.
Someone has been stealing the neutralizing agent canisters from HazGuard kits and replacing them with something that accelerates burns.
